extension.description: A Kodi metadata scraper for movies, backed by your self-hosted Chronicle server. Unlike a normal scraper, it never talks to TMDB or any other upstream source directly -- it only ever asks Chronicle, which resolves-and-creates the item through whichever metadata providers you've already configured there, so Kodi always ends up seeing exactly what Chronicle itself would show for that title. Distinct from Chronicle_Scrobbler (which reports watch progress) -- this addon supplies library metadata during "Change Content" / library scans.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release: movie search/details backed by Chronicle's new /api/v1/scraper/movies endpoints. Connect to Chronicle via the same QR/PIN device-auth flow as Chronicle_Scrobbler.
